tool_schemas.name: sequentialthinking_tools
tool_schemas.description: Appends a thought event to an existing sequential-thinking session (or continues the session timeline) and returns the updated session guidance, including the current step recommendation plus any previous and remaining steps when provided. Requests must include thought, next_thought_needed, thought_number (>=1), and total_thoughts (>=1); if is_revision is true then revises_thought (>=1) must be set, and if branching is used then branch_from_thought (>=1) and branch_id must be valid for the session’s existing timeline. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields or inconsistent revision/branch references, NOT_FOUND if the referenced session/branch/thought does not exist, CONFLICT if the thought_number is out of sequence or attempts an invalid state transition (e.g., updating a completed session), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or QUOTA_EXCEEDED when access is not permitted or usage limits are exceeded.

next_thought_needed.description: Whether another thought step is needed

tool_name.description: Name of the tool being recommended

alternatives.description: Alternative tools that could be used

expected_outcome.description: What to expect from this step

next_step_conditions.description: Conditions to consider for the next step

tool_schemas.name: sequentialthinking_tools_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling API key identity, its workspace, allowed toolset, and current quota/rate-limit usage. Refuses requests made with a revoked key or a non-active workspace.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate (e.g., sent as the vendor key value).

tool_schemas.name: sequentialthinking_tools_create_session
tool_schemas.description: Explicitly creates a new sequential-thinking session with a title and tool context. Validates the workspace is active, the API key is active, tool_context is a non-empty subset of the key's allowed_tools, and workspace active-session quota is not exceeded; returns the created session record.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate (must be active and belong to an active workspace).

session_id.description: Client-supplied session identifier; if omitted, the service generates one.

tool_context.description: Tools allowed to be recommended/used during this session; must be a non-empty subset of api_keys.allowed_tools.

estimated_total_thoughts.description: Optional initial estimate of total thoughts expected.

tool_schemas.name: sequentialthinking_tools_get_session
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single thinking session by id, including its current guidance fields (current_thought_number, next_thought_needed, needs_more_thoughts, remaining_steps) and status. Refuses access if the session does not belong to the calling API key's workspace or if the key/workspace is not active.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate.

tool_schemas.name: sequentialthinking_tools_list_sessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists thinking sessions for the authenticated workspace, with filtering by lifecycle status and time range. Returns paginated results and refuses requests from revoked keys or non-active workspaces.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate.

created_after.description: Only include sessions created at or after this time (RFC 3339 timestamp).

created_before.description: Only include sessions created before this time (RFC 3339 timestamp).

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: sequentialthinking_tools_list_thoughts
tool_schemas.description: Lists thoughts within a session timeline, optionally scoped to a branch. Returns paginated results ordered by thought_number and rejects access if the session is not in the caller's workspace or if key/workspace is not active.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate.

session_id.description: Thinking session id whose thoughts should be listed.

branch_id.description: If provided, only return thoughts in this branch.

limit.description: Maximum number of thoughts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: sequentialthinking_tools_update_session
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable session fields and/or performs allowed lifecycle transitions. Supports transitioning status according to the session lifecycle (active→completed/cancelled/archived; completed/cancelled→archived). Refuses invalid transitions, rejects if key/workspace is not active, and validates tool_context remains a non-empty subset of api_keys.allowed_tools.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate.

tool_context.description: Replace the session tool context; must be a non-empty subset of api_keys.allowed_tools.

status.description: Requested lifecycle state transition (must be valid from the current state).

estimated_total_thoughts.description: Update the session estimate of total thoughts expected.
